Dear Participant,

Thank you for registering for the Madras Open Quiz 2020.

The prelims will be conducted at 12 noon on 30th August 2020 (Sunday). The
prelims will be conducted through the Quizizz Application.

The following are the rules to be kept in mind for the prelims:

a. The prelims will consist of 40 questions. It will be entirely in
Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) format.

b. Each question will have to be answered within 45 seconds.

c.
*If 45 seconds have elapsed, and you have not answered the question, the
next question will automatically display. You will not be able to go back
to the previous question.*
d. Questions marked with asterisk (*) are starred questions for resolving
ties.

e.
*The link will be open for participation between 12 to 12.40 pm (For 40
minutes).*
f. Participants are required to enter the exact mobile number used for
registration as their login ID in the Quizizz application.
NO other number entered will be considered. There is NO need for the
country code to be entered. NO names are to be entered.
Remember, the number provided for registration (10 numbers for India or
less for participants abroad will suffice) is only to be entered.

g. The Top 6 participants will be selected who will take part in the Finals
over Google Meet. The Finals will begin at 3pm and will be streamed live.

h. The link for the prelims will be provided 1 hour before the start of the
prelims to the registered E-Mail addresses of the participants.

Happy Quizzing!

For
